description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database visualizer interface, providing UI components and JavaScript for interacting with databases, tables, and data display.
external_files: None directly referenced; external dependencies include standard web APIs

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of available databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by reloading data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data as an HTML table, handling wide content and expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell values, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content on click to show full data.
